verdict.rationale: Box's Events API is documented as a subscribable event feed that can be queried in real time or against historical records via stream types, which functions as the delta/cursor mechanism developers use instead of full re-crawls (box-docs-8, box-docs-19, box-docs-39). Missing for 10: explicit mention of 'stream_position' cursor parameter/token semantics, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the feed reliably captures only incremental changes without gaps.
